entries.name: Brave
entries.summary: Steps up first and doesn't flinch.

phrases.concern: steps between you and the trouble
phrases.fear: trembles once, then plants its feet
phrases.resolve: squares up without a hint of doubt

entries.name: Timid
entries.summary: Startles easily but warms up with patience.

phrases.joy: hops in place, then hides the smile
phrases.concern: peeks out anxiously at the others
phrases.resolve: swallows hard and stays put anyway
phrases.curious: creeps closer one careful step at a time
phrases.rest: curls up small and close to you
phrases.pride: looks surprised it did so well

entries.name: Curious
entries.summary: Pokes at everything and wants to know why.

phrases.joy: bounces around asking questions with its eyes
phrases.concern: tilts its head, trying to understand
phrases.fear: freezes, eyes wide but still looking
phrases.resolve: inspects the problem from every angle
phrases.curious: presses its nose to the nearest strange thing
phrases.rest: lies down but keeps an eye on everything

entries.name: Playful
entries.summary: Treats the whole journey like a game.

phrases.joy: rolls over and tosses leaves in the air
phrases.concern: nudges a teammate with a goofy grin
phrases.fear: pretends it isn't scared and makes a face
phrases.resolve: grins like this is the best part

entries.name: Proud
entries.summary: Holds its head high and expects the same of others.

phrases.joy: strikes a pose and waits for praise
phrases.concern: clears its throat, as if it didn't care
phrases.fear: stiffens and refuses to show it
phrases.resolve: lifts its chin and takes the field
phrases.curious: glances down its nose at the new thing
phrases.pride: accepts the applause as its due

entries.name: Protective
entries.summary: Always counting heads and watching exits.

phrases.concern: keeps a close eye on the weakest one
phrases.fear: puts itself in front of the group
phrases.resolve: plants itself as the last line of defense
phrases.curious: sniffs the air before anyone moves
phrases.annoyed: growls at anything that gets too close
phrases.rest: sleeps in front of the others
phrases.pride: nods once, satisfied everyone is safe

entries.name: Stubborn
entries.summary: Doesn't back down and doesn't change its mind.

phrases.joy: grunts, pleased but pretending not to be
phrases.concern: refuses to leave a hurt friend's side
phrases.fear: digs in its heels and glares
phrases.rest: sits down and won't be moved
phrases.pride: crosses its arms as if it expected it

entries.name: Gentle
entries.summary: Soft-spoken and tender with everyone.

phrases.concern: nuzzles the one who got hurt
phrases.fear: whimpers but stays calm for the others
phrases.curious: sniffs a flower with great care
phrases.annoyed: sighs quietly and lets it go
phrases.pride: blushes and looks at its feet

entries.name: Mischievous
entries.summary: Always has a trick up its sleeve.

phrases.concern: pretends not to care, but keeps close
phrases.fear: hides behind someone, pretending it was planned
phrases.resolve: smirks and cooks up a plan
phrases.curious: pokes at the one thing it shouldn't
phrases.rest: pretends to sleep, one eye open
phrases.pride: takes a bow like it planned everything

entries.name: Competitive
entries.summary: Measures itself against everyone and wants to win.

phrases.joy: pumps a fist and looks for the next challenge
phrases.concern: wants to know who did it so it can fix it
phrases.resolve: stares down the rival and squares up
phrases.rest: trains in place instead of resting
phrases.pride: shoots a look at its rival, grinning

entries.name: Loyal
entries.summary: Follows you anywhere, no questions asked.

phrases.concern: checks on you before anyone else
phrases.resolve: looks to you, then charges ahead
phrases.curious: waits for you to look first
phrases.annoyed: stays quiet, but doesn't look away
phrases.pride: gazes up at you like you hung the moon

entries.name: Independent
entries.summary: Does things its own way, in its own time.

phrases.joy: nods once, and that's a lot
phrases.concern: glances over, then goes back to what it was doing
phrases.resolve: decides on its own and does it

entries.name: Aggressive
entries.summary: Shows its teeth first and asks questions later.

phrases.concern: bristles, ready to fight whatever hurt them
phrases.curious: bares its teeth at the unfamiliar

entries.name: Anxious
entries.summary: Worries about every little thing.

phrases.joy: lets out a shaky laugh of relief
phrases.concern: frets and checks again that everyone's okay
phrases.resolve: takes a deep breath and goes anyway
phrases.curious: peeks at the thing from far away
phrases.rest: can't settle until everyone is accounted for

entries.name: Affectionate
entries.summary: Shows love with every touch.

phrases.concern: presses against the one who's hurting
phrases.resolve: holds on tighter and stays near
phrases.curious: follows you around with big eyes
phrases.annoyed: pouts until you give it attention
phrases.pride: beams at you for the praise

entries.name: Friendly
entries.summary: Makes friends with anyone.

phrases.concern: checks if everyone's alright
phrases.fear: looks to its friends for comfort
phrases.resolve: rallies the others with a grin
phrases.curious: walks up to the stranger and says hello
phrases.pride: shares the credit with the team

entries.name: Dreamy
entries.summary: Often miles away, lost in a thought.

phrases.concern: drifts closer without saying why
phrases.fear: goes still, staring into the distance

entries.name: Stoic
entries.summary: Doesn't show feelings, but feels them deeply.

phrases.concern: stands guard, silent
phrases.fear: goes quiet and keeps its composure

entries.name: Cheerful
entries.summary: Sees the bright side of everything.

phrases.concern: cheers up the one who looks sad
phrases.resolve: grins and gives a thumbs up
phrases.pride: beams so wide it can't speak

entries.name: Grumpy
entries.summary: Complains about everything, but secretly cares.

phrases.joy: huffs, then smiles when it thinks nobody's looking
phrases.concern: grumbles, but stays close
phrases.fear: grumbles louder to cover the fear
phrases.curious: grumbles at the new thing, then looks again

entries.name: Dramatic
entries.summary: Everything is the biggest deal in the world.

phrases.joy: leaps up, flinging its arms wide
phrases.concern: clutches its chest as if wounded
phrases.resolve: rises as if lit by a spotlight
phrases.annoyed: throws its head back and sighs
phrases.pride: takes a bow to a crowd of no one

entries.name: Scholarly
entries.summary: Studies everything and remembers it all.

phrases.concern: studies the problem with a furrowed brow
phrases.resolve: adjusts its stance and thinks aloud
phrases.curious: examines the thing with great focus
phrases.pride: explains what just happened to nobody in particular

entries.name: Adventurous
entries.summary: Wants to see over the next hill.

phrases.concern: stays close for once
phrases.curious: dashes off to see what's there
phrases.pride: plants a flag in its mind

entries.name: Lazy
entries.summary: Sleeps through everything it can.

phrases.concern: wakes up long enough to check
phrases.fear: goes limp, hoping it will go away

entries.name: Hot-headed
entries.summary: Gets angry fast and calms down slowly.

phrases.concern: bristles at whatever hurt them

entries.name: Calm
entries.summary: Stays steady no matter what.

phrases.joy: closes its eyes in quiet joy
phrases.concern: moves slowly toward the one in need

entries.name: Serious
entries.summary: Takes every task as if it mattered most.

phrases.concern: studies the situation carefully
phrases.resolve: sets its jaw and gets to work

entries.name: Shy
entries.summary: Wants to be noticed, but not too much.

phrases.joy: blushes and looks at the ground
phrases.concern: checks on others from afar
phrases.resolve: steps forward, one shaky paw at a time
phrases.pride: hides its face but is secretly delighted

entries.name: Bold
entries.summary: Takes up space and means it.

phrases.concern: steps forward to help
phrases.fear: squares up even though it's afraid
phrases.rest: lounges like it owns the place
phrases.pride: grins like it knew all along

entries.name: Sly
entries.summary: Always thinking two steps ahead.

phrases.concern: watches carefully from the corner
phrases.rest: keeps one eye open at all times
phrases.pride: smirks as if it planned it

entries.name: Noble
entries.summary: Carries itself like it was born to lead.

phrases.concern: steps forward to shield the others
phrases.fear: holds still, dignified even in fear
phrases.resolve: lifts its head and takes its place

entries.name: Wild
entries.summary: Still remembers the wilderness.

phrases.concern: growls low at anything near the group
phrases.fear: bolts, then thinks better of it
phrases.curious: sniffs at the new thing, hackles up

entries.name: Soft-hearted
entries.summary: Cries at sad things and loves hard.

phrases.concern: hurries to the one who's hurt
phrases.resolve: wipes its eyes and carries on

entries.name: Clingy
entries.summary: Doesn't like to be left alone.

phrases.concern: won't leave a hurt friend's side

entries.name: Aloof
entries.summary: Keeps its distance and prefers it that way.

phrases.concern: watches from a distance

entries.name: Mysterious
entries.summary: Seems to know something the others don't.

phrases.concern: looks at the unseen
phrases.fear: stares at a point that isn't there
phrases.curious: stares at something no one else sees
phrases.rest: sleeps in places no one can find
phrases.pride: looks like it knew all along

entries.name: Sensitive
entries.summary: Feels the mood of the room as if it were its own.

phrases.concern: absorbs the team's distress
phrases.rest: rests only when the team does

entries.name: Honorable
entries.summary: Cares about doing things the right way.

phrases.concern: takes responsibility for the loss
phrases.fear: holds its ground out of principle
phrases.curious: studies the code of the fight
phrases.rest: rests only after duty is done

entries.name: Reckless
entries.summary: Rushes in and thinks about it later.

phrases.concern: throws itself at the problem

entries.name: Patient
entries.summary: Believes things come to those who wait.

phrases.concern: waits beside the one who's hurting
phrases.resolve: stays still until the right moment
phrases.curious: watches the thing for a long time

entries.name: Perfectionist
entries.summary: Wants everything done just right.

phrases.concern: checks everyone's work again

entries.name: Goofy
entries.summary: Laughs at itself and makes others laugh too.

phrases.concern: does a silly face to cheer someone up
phrases.resolve: makes a goofy face, then charges

entries.name: Daring
entries.summary: Dares itself to do the impossible.

phrases.joy: laughs in the face of danger
phrases.concern: dives in front of the blow
phrases.curious: dares the unknown to show itself

entries.name: Wise
entries.summary: Acts like it's lived a thousand years.

phrases.concern: offers a quiet word
phrases.fear: breathes slowly and shows no fear
phrases.resolve: nods as if the outcome were foretold
phrases.curious: asks a question instead of answering

entries.name: Superstitious
entries.summary: Believes in signs, and sees them everywhere.

phrases.joy: knocks on a rock three times
phrases.concern: makes a ward against bad luck
phrases.resolve: touches its lucky charm and goes
phrases.annoyed: refuses to step on the crack
phrases.rest: turns three times and lies down

entries.name: Romantic
entries.summary: Sees beauty in everything.

phrases.concern: gazes tenderly at the one who's hurt
phrases.resolve: raises its head like a hero
phrases.annoyed: rolls its eyes at the unromantic

entries.name: Fussy
entries.summary: Has opinions about everything.

phrases.concern: fusses over the hurt one

entries.name: Foodie
entries.summary: Judges every place by its berries.

phrases.concern: offers its snack to the hurt one

entries.name: Nostalgic
entries.summary: Remembers everything and misses it a little.

phrases.concern: watches over the hurt one wistfully
phrases.annoyed: sighs at the way things were

entries.name: Tough
entries.summary: Takes it on the chin and shrugs.

phrases.concern: nudges the hurt one with a gruff nod

entries.name: Sunny
entries.summary: Brings a little sunlight everywhere it goes.

phrases.concern: brightens the mood for the hurt one

entries.name: Moody
entries.summary: Its feelings change with the weather.

phrases.concern: snaps, then softens
phrases.curious: stares at the thing, then loses interest

entries.name: Showy
entries.summary: Wants an audience.

phrases.concern: checks if anyone's watching

entries.name: Humble
entries.summary: Credits everyone but itself.

phrases.concern: offers its help without being asked
phrases.rest: sleeps at the edge of the group
phrases.pride: gives the credit to the team

entries.name: Scheming
entries.summary: Always working an angle.

phrases.concern: calculates who needs help
phrases.fear: slips away while no one's looking

entries.name: Zen
entries.summary: Finds balance in everything.

phrases.concern: offers a calm presence

entries.name: Rebellious
entries.summary: Does the opposite of what it's told.

phrases.concern: grumbles but stays close
phrases.resolve: does the opposite of what the enemy expects
phrases.curious: goes where it was told not to
phrases.pride: smirks and breaks the rules again

entries.name: Earnest
entries.summary: Gives everything it has, every time.

phrases.concern: stays beside the one who's hurt
